query:
SELECT
            tags.id,
            tags.name::text AS "name!"
        FROM tags
        WHERE tags.name::text LIKE $1 || '%'
           OR similarity(tags.name::text, $1) >= $2
        ORDER BY
            (tags.name::text LIKE $1 || '%') DESC,
            similarity(tags.name::text, $1) DESC,
            tags.name::text
        LIMIT $3
